article.title: Punishment for wilful and material omissions from statements relating to affairs of corporate debtor.
article.content: Where an officer of the corporate debtor makes any material and wilful omission in any statement relating to the affairs of the corporate debtor, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than three years but which may extend to five years, or with fine which shall not be less than one lakh rupees, but may extend to one crore rupees, or with both.
article.html:
72Punishment for wilful and material omissions from statements relating to affairs of corporate debtor.

Section 72 · Part II · Chapter VII · page 86 of the Act

Where an officer of the corporate debtor makes any material and wilful omission in any statement relating to the affairs of the corporate debtor, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than three years but which may extend to five years, or with fine which shall not be less than one lakh rupees, but may extend to one crore rupees, or with both.
